headline: Steady sales growth offset by a heavier tax bill
summary_short: Revenue rose 9.9% y/y to $5,661.5M on comparable club sales of +6.3% and general-merchandise strength, but net income fell 4.7% y/y to $142.7M as the effective tax rate climbed to 27.0% from 22.2%.
summary_long: Q1 FY2026 net sales rose 9.9% y/y to $5.53B on 6.3% comparable club sales (general merchandise +7.1%, gasoline +4.8%) plus nine net new clubs. Merchandise gross margin slipped ~10bp on continued pricing investment, partly offset by tariff refund benefits. SG&A grew 5.9% on new-club labor/occupancy costs; pre-opening expense nearly tripled to $14.0M. Net income fell 4.7% y/y to $142.7M as the effective tax rate rose to 27.0% from 22.2%; diluted EPS fell 2.7% to $1.10, cushioned by a 2.5% lower share count from $206.6M of buybacks. Cash fell to $27.8M; adjusted free cash flow was -$42.0M on higher capex and working-capital swings. Company projects a 27.4% FY2026 effective tax rate.
